entry.author: New Zealand Story
entry.summary:
🍵 Paving the way for the tea industry in New Zealand, @Zealong Tea Estate, located in the heart of Waikato, is the world's largest internationally certified organic tea farm!

Combining ancient traditions with innovation, Zealong stands out in the world of tea. With Organic Certification, a focus on sustainability, and no-compromise quality, Zealong is truly unique in the tea industry. 🌏
